name: Container Runtime Security Assessment
description: Assessment of container runtime security controls and monitoring. Covers runtime threat detection, syscall filtering (seccomp), mandatory access control (AppArmor/SELinux), runtime anomaly detection tools (Falco, Sysdig), and evaluation of runtime defense effectiveness.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to container runtime security assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands container runtime security concepts and monitoring approaches
evidence: Can explain seccomp profiles, AppArmor/SELinux, and their role in container security
Understands runtime threat detection concepts and common evasion patterns
Familiar with runtime security tools (Falco, Sysdig, Tetragon)

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Evaluates runtime security configurations under supervision
evidence: Reviews seccomp and AppArmor profiles against lab baselines under guidance
Deploys and configures runtime monitoring tools in test environments
Documents runtime security findings with supervision

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses runtime security posture and detection capabilities
evidence: Independently evaluates seccomp profiles and MAC policies for completeness
Tests runtime detection tool efficacy against known attack techniques
Identifies gaps in runtime monitoring coverage
Produces compliant runtime security assessment reports

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Develops runtime detection rules and evasion techniques; mentors others
evidence: Develops custom runtime detection rules for advanced attack scenarios
Demonstrates evasion of runtime monitoring through fileless and kernel-level techniques
Reviews runtime security assessment work of junior analysts
Contributes to lab runtime security methodology

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines lab runtime security methodology; publishes research on runtime attacks and defenses
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's container runtime security assessment framework
Published research on runtime evasion techniques or novel detection methods
Trains teams on advanced runtime security assessment
Recognized as authority on container runtime security

assessment_methods.description: Execute known container attack techniques against a monitored environment and evaluate detection coverage
Observe runtime security assessment during a live engagement, evaluating methodology and thoroughness
